cases.title: Community gallery proposal
cases.subtitle: A submission window confirmed by a recorded human decision

sources.title: Gallery call for proposals
sources.label: Original call · 02 Feb 2027
sources.text:
Applications open on 2 February 2027.
Send the final proposal by 18 February 2027 (17:00), local time.
Rehearsals start on 23 February 2027.

lines.text: Send the final proposal by 18 February 2027 (17:00), local time.

sources.title: Coordinator review note
sources.label: Human review record · 04 Feb 2027
sources.text:
Reviewed the gallery call. Confirmed proposal deadline: 18 February 2027 at 17:00.
The rehearsal start is a separate milestone, not the filing deadline.

lines.text: Reviewed the gallery call. Confirmed proposal deadline: 18 February 2027 at 17:00.
The rehearsal start is a separate milestone, not the filing deadline.

stages.title: The invitation distinguishes three dates
stages.label: Call received
stages.detail: The invitation gives an opening date, a proposal deadline and a rehearsal date.

stages.title: 18 February 2027 at 17:00
stages.label: Candidate found
stages.detail: The candidate time comes from the final proposal instruction. It stays provisional until human review.

stages.title: Filing deadline confirmed
stages.label: Confirmed
stages.detail: The review independently records the same filing time. Trace the decision to its review note and the source it confirmed.

cases.title: Studio access application
cases.subtitle: Conflicting due dates stay visible until someone reconciles them

sources.title: Studio access guide
sources.label: Published guide · 12 Feb 2027
sources.text:
Studio access opens to residents in March 2027.
The access form must reach the desk by 2 March 2027 at 12:00.

lines.text: Studio access opens to residents in March 2027.
The access form must reach the desk by 2 March 2027 at 12:00.

sources.title: Studio application handout
sources.label: Printed allocation sheet · 14 Feb 2027
sources.text:
Studio access applications close on 5 March 2027 at 12:00.
The desk will release its decision on 12 March 2027.

lines.text: Studio access applications close on 5 March 2027 at 12:00.
The desk will release its decision on 12 March 2027.

stages.title: The published guide gives an application cut-off
stages.label: First source
stages.detail: The guide names 2 March 2027 at 12:00 as the deadline for the access form.

stages.title: 2 March and 5 March both claim to close applications
stages.label: Dates disagree
stages.detail: The handout names a different filing cut-off. There is no evidence that either source supersedes the other.

stages.title: Ask the studio desk to confirm the deadline
stages.label: Needs review
stages.detail: Keep both sources attached. Only an explicit confirmation can resolve the conflict.

cases.title: Workshop safety brief
cases.subtitle: An event start date cannot fill a missing submission deadline

sources.title: Workshop invitation
sources.label: Event notice · 22 Feb 2027
sources.text:
The build workshop starts on 22 March 2027.
Bring protective glasses to the optional orientation on 20 March.
Send your safety method statement to the workshop desk for review.

lines.text: The build workshop starts on 22 March 2027.
Bring protective glasses to the optional orientation on 20 March.
Send your safety method statement to the workshop desk for review.

stages.title: A submission is requested
stages.label: Invitation received
stages.detail: The invitation asks for a safety method statement. It specifies when the workshop and orientation take place.

stages.title: No due date is stated
stages.label: Deadline absent
stages.detail: The source gives two event dates but supplies no deadline for the statement. Leave the deadline unset.

stages.title: Ask when the statement must arrive
stages.label: Needs review
stages.detail: A confirmation from the workshop desk is needed before a filing deadline can be recorded.
